theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+4.48%) and Health Care (+1.47%) led the market today, while Utilities (-1.28%) and Real Estate (-1.25%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.08%, defensives +0.00%, and value/cyclicals +0.61% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.06%, Dow -0.11%, Nasdaq -0.32% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.56%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 3.83% to 15.46, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 1.39% to $4,448.60, crude oil was little changed at $82.30, and bitcoin slipped 1.23% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
